question: GQ-001
subject: a 128-second regression that did not exist
what_i_concluded: a sharp non-linear regression at 4.65M passages — 798ms to 128s for the same query
how_i_disproved_it: printed-only 371ms and modern-only 457ms — each half fast, so I blamed the exclusion
the script's EXACT modern query measured 412ms and its exact printed query 328ms
every component was fast, so I re-ran the CLI itself: 781ms, 783ms
the_actual_cause: the observatory build was still reading the database when I took the first timings. Contention, not the query.

a_second_false_alarm_in_the_same_check.cause: cold cache — the vault is USB, so the first touch after a rebuild pays disk

the_lesson: I took three measurements while a writer held the database and nearly recorded a defect that does not exist. A timing taken during contention is not a timing. Every number here is now from a warmed, uncontended repeat.
